column2: Rahu and Ketu are the nodes (Shadow planets) and have got an anti clockwise motion in the heavens. They are invisible planets and are caused by the intersection of the pathways of the Sun and the Moon. The intersection occurring North of Equator is called Rahu (asceding node or Dragon's head) and that of the South is called Ketu, (descending node or Dragon's tail). They adopt themselves the characters of the conjunct planets, opposing planets, star lords, and the sign lords where they transit, mainly. Rahu indicates the paternal grand-father and Ketu indicates maternal grand-father. They are 180° exactly opposite to each other. Both of them have control over the spleen and cause severe pain and gas trouble. Rahu controls black-gram and Ketu controls Horse-gram. Rahu's gem is Gomedh and Ketu's gem is Vaidooryam. They rule over dark places, caves and tunnels. They rule ove snakes, monkey, wolf, camel, poisonous insects, mosquito, bugs, virus, and bacteria.
